verdicts.title: Peak greenness well below this field's normal
verdicts.detail: Peak NDVI 0.50 was 78% of the 0.64 median peak of this field's 6 other cropped seasons, and growth summed over the season was 70% of usual; the curve alone cannot tell a failed crop from an unsown or weedy field.

verdicts.title: Peak greenness well below this field's normal
verdicts.detail: Peak NDVI 0.52 was 77% of the 0.67 median peak of this field's 5 other cropped seasons, and growth summed over the season was 58% of usual.

verdicts.title: Dry canopy at peak, consistent with a water shortage
verdicts.detail: The canopy moisture index (NDMI) at peak was -0.01, 0.16 below this field's usual +0.16, which supports a water explanation for the low peak.

verdicts.title: Too few clear satellite passes to judge this season
verdicts.detail: Only 2 of the 5 ten-day periods in the main growing window (21 June to 10 August) had a cloud-free view of the field, too few to read the season's peak.

modis.note: NASA MODIS at 250 m: the highest NDVI between June and late August of each year. MODIS reads about 0.1 higher than Sentinel-2, so compare MODIS years only with each other. A year with a peak under 0.41 is shown as fallow. 2025 is left out: the source archive has no MODIS data from 26 June to 17 November 2025.
